title: Three-dimensional Analysis of Rotational Particle Image Velocimetry (3D PIV) Data
abstract: The paper presents a method for three-dimensional analysis of rotational particle image velocimetry (3D PIV) data. This method is applied to the characterization of a complex fluid flow. The goal is to offer a convenient framework for the identification and analysis of coherent structures within the flow. The method is validated using both synthetic and experimental data. Results are in agreement with the expected behavior of the studied fluid dynamic fields.
summary: This paper presents a method for analyzing rotational PIV data to characterize fluid flows. The study focuses on providing a methodological framework for identifying coherent structures in 3D velocity fields. The approach was validated through experimentation with synthetic and real-world data, proving its utility for complex fluids. After conducting a web search, there appear to be no direct citations or references to this paper in subsequent research literature or industry applications. However, the methodology proposed could have a potential impact on improving the analysis of fluid dynamics, especially in scenarios that require a deep understanding of three-dimensional flow characteristics.
